Definition: perhaps from the base of G3313 (through the idea of adjustment of parts); shape; figuratively, nature:--form.
BiblicalUsage: Morphe is form, the outward shape that shows what a thing truly is. Christ, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God, but took upon Him the form of a servant, and after the resurrection He appeared in another form to two disciples on the road.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word guards the mystery. He did not cease to be God when He took the servant's form, and He did not cease to be the servant when He rose.
RelatedTopics: Christology; Hypostatic Union; Son of God
